dimensionEvidence.application: Only the 267 mm published reference-card length is used for display normalization. The other axes preserve the community model's proportions; slot width, height and complete fit geometry have not been verified.

additions.review: Creator identifies RX 6900 XT; actual source mesh has three fans, Radeon markings, a stylized reference shroud/backplate and two power connectors. Low-detail appearance with creator colors retained. No exact partner SKU is established. Only rx6900xt is mapped.
additions.limitations: Appearance only, not certified CAD, installation, clearance or thermals. Exact partner appearance, mounting positions, cable bend space and material accuracy remain unverified.

boundedResearch.selection: Exclude installed UIDs; require an individually current downloadable CC BY asset and a matching existing catalog identity. Unnamed family models, packaging, unrelated scenes and mismatched H500i/H500 cases are not counted as new coverage.
